name: Splunk
description: Workflows covering Splunk's core management REST API: search job lifecycle, saved search CRUD/dispatch/history, and index list/create/get/update.

1.name: ListSearchJobs
1.description: Lists current and recently completed search jobs.

count.description: Maximum number of entries to return. 0 means return all entries.

offset.description: Index of the first entry to return, for pagination.

filter.description: Filter the list to entries matching this expression.

2.name: CreateSearchJob
2.description: Creates a search job. Returns immediately with a search ID (sid) unless exec_mode is set to blocking or oneshot.

search.description: The search query to run, e.g. "search index=main error".

exec_mode.description: normal dispatches and returns a sid immediately; blocking waits for completion; oneshot runs synchronously.

earliest_time.description: Earliest time bound for the search, e.g. "-24h".

latest_time.description: Latest time bound for the search, e.g. "now".

max_count.description: Maximum number of results the job keeps in memory.

status_buckets.description: Number of timeline summary buckets to generate.

3.name: GetSearchJobStatus
3.description: Returns the status and properties of a search job, including dispatchState, doneProgress, resultCount, and eventCount.

4.name: CancelSearchJob
4.description: Cancels a search job and removes it from the dispatch directory.

5.name: ControlSearchJob
5.description: Applies a control action (pause, unpause, finalize, cancel, touch, setttl, setpriority) to a search job.

action.description: Control action to apply to the job.

ttl.description: New time-to-live in seconds. Required when action is setttl.

priority.description: New OS process priority (0-10). Required when action is setpriority.

6.name: GetSearchJobResults
6.description: Returns the final, transformed results of a completed search job.

count.description: Maximum number of entries to return. 0 means return all entries.

offset.description: Index of the first entry to return, for pagination.

post_process_search.description: A post-process search to further filter or transform the returned results.

7.name: GetSearchJobEvents
7.description: Returns the untransformed events of a search job. Available before the search has finished running.

count.description: Maximum number of entries to return. 0 means return all entries.

offset.description: Index of the first entry to return, for pagination.

post_process_search.description: A post-process search to further filter or transform the returned events.

8.name: ExportSearchResults
8.description: Runs a search and streams results as they become available, without creating a persistent search job.

earliest_time.description: Earliest time bound for the search.

latest_time.description: Latest time bound for the search.

max_count.description: Maximum number of results to return.

count.description: Maximum number of entries to return. 0 means return all entries.

offset.description: Index of the first entry to return, for pagination.

filter.description: Filter the list to entries matching this expression.

is_scheduled.description: Whether this saved search runs on the cron_schedule.

cron_schedule.description: Cron expression controlling when this search runs, e.g. "*/5 * * * *".

dispatch.earliest_time.description: Earliest time bound applied when this saved search runs.

dispatch.latest_time.description: Latest time bound applied when this saved search runs.

actions.description: Comma-separated list of alert actions to trigger, e.g. "email".

action.email.to.description: Email recipient(s) when the email action is enabled.

b.name: GetSavedSearch
b.description: Returns the configuration of a specific saved search.

c.name: UpdateSavedSearch
c.description: Updates the configuration of a specific saved search.

e.name: DispatchSavedSearch
e.description: Runs a saved search immediately, outside of its normal schedule, and returns a search job ID.

dispatch.now.description: Reference time used to resolve relative time modifiers for this dispatch.

trigger_actions.description: Whether to trigger the saved search's configured alert actions if conditions are met.

f.name: GetSavedSearchHistory
f.description: Returns the search jobs created by previous dispatches of a saved search.

10.name: ListIndexes
10.description: Lists indexes on the Splunk instance.

count.description: Maximum number of entries to return. 0 means return all entries.

offset.description: Index of the first entry to return, for pagination.

name.description: Name of the index to create.

maxTotalDataSizeMB.description: Maximum combined size, in MB, of all hot/warm/cold buckets before data rolls to frozen.

frozenTimePeriodInSecs.description: Number of seconds after which indexed data rolls to frozen.

12.name: GetIndex
12.description: Returns the configuration and status of a specific index.

13.name: UpdateIndex
13.description: Updates the configuration of a specific index, including enabling/disabling it and adjusting retention/size limits.

disabled.description: Set true to disable the index, false to enable it.
